name: outbox-email-scheduler
description: Production-minded email scheduler: Express + BullMQ + Redis + PostgreSQL + Elasticsearch + React

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev:worker -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
